root_idea.summary: The root has a prominent semantic branch concerning an excuse: speech or action offered to remove blame or establish exculpation. Classical lexicography also preserves several largely independent branches involving cutting, bridling, marks, bodily conditions, and related objects.
root_idea.development: The excuse branch develops around removing or cancelling blame and presenting grounds for being excused; other branches are treated as separate lexical formations rather than as predictable extensions of one single root principle.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form VIII perfect citation form.
مَعَاذِير is the supplied Quranic plural of مَعْذِرَة and is presented under the singular dictionary citation form.
Displayed under the normalized singular nominal citation form.
The Quranic plural active participle is normalized to the singular active-participle citation form مُعَذِّر.

senses.definition: To excuse oneself; to present or plead an excuse or plea, including a claim of being clear of blame.
senses.usage_conditions: Used with constructions such as excusing oneself to someone, for a fault, or from an act. The Quranic occurrences concern people presenting or being told not to present such pleas.

senses.definition: An excuse, apology, justification, or plea offered to remove blame.
senses.usage_conditions: The lexical tradition describes an excuse as a denial, an explanation of circumstances that removes culpability, or a resolve not to repeat the act; the last type overlaps with repentance but is not identical with every excuse.

senses.definition: An excuse or plea by which one seeks to be excused or cleared of blame.
senses.usage_conditions: In قَالُوا مَعْذِرَةً إِلَى رَبِّكُمْ it denotes an act or statement of seeking to establish an excuse; elsewhere it denotes an excuse or plea attributed to a person. The plural form is مَعَاذِير.

senses.definition: Excuses or argumentative pleas presented as coverings over wrongdoing.
senses.usage_conditions: This sense belongs specifically to the Quranic plural مَعَاذِير in the construction وَلَوْ أَلْقَى مَعَاذِيرَهُ; the lexical interpretation also allows the image of veils or coverings over offenses.

senses.definition: One who presents an excuse, especially one who offers a feigned or invalid excuse while falling short of what is required.
senses.usage_conditions: The canonical Quranic active participle with teshdid is associated with people who come forward with excuses without a genuine valid excuse. Lexical tradition also records a lightened reading for those who truly have an excuse; that reading is not a separate QAC form group here.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To excuse, exculpate, or clear someone from blame; to accept his excuse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May be construed with the person excused and with the matter for which or from which he is excused.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be so faulty or sinful that the person who punishes him is considered excusable.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct Form I use describing conduct that makes punishment warranted.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To aid or assist someone against an enemy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional Form I use, distinct from the excuse sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cut or cut off.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verbal meaning associated with the cutting branch of the root.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To circumcise.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a boy and, less commonly, of a girl; the corresponding noun also denotes circumcision.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put a cheek-strap or bridle on a horse, or to attach a cheek-strap to a bridle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is the عِذَار, the part of a bridle extending along the cheek or cheeks.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a mark or brand, especially at the place of a cheek-strap; figuratively, to mark someone with blame.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes branding or cauterizing an animal and related expressions of leaving a visible mark.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone to suffer the throat ailment called عُذْرَة; to be affected by it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily-condition use, not an excuse meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To prepare or invite people to a feast, especially a feast associated with circumcision or another joyful occasion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The feast may be called إِعْذَار or عِذَار.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To brand a camel with a mark different from another camel's so that they can be distinguished.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A marking use of the intensive Form II.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a boy, for the hair of the cheek or sideburn to grow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Refers to hair growing in the place of the عِذَار.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To efface the traces of a house or dwelling.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II use concerning the removal of visible remains.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To defile or besmear something with human ordure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is a thing made dirty with عَذِرَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become excusable, to provide an excuse, or to do what leaves one without blame.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used for manifesting or pleading an excuse, exceeding the usual bounds in establishing one, or taking extraordinary pains so as to be excused.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To obtain one's due or right from another, or to undertake to excuse one's conduct.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional Form IV use interpreted either as obtaining justice or as arranging an excuse, depending on context.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be remiss or deficient while making it appear that one is doing the opposite.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported contrary-looking Form IV use, related to feigning an excuse without fulfilling the obligation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a mark by beating, striking, or otherwise leaving a scar.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person, back, house, or share when a visible mark is produced.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To void ordure; of a house, to contain much human ordure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily or environmental use distinct from the excuse branch.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To draw back, hold back, remain behind, flee, or withhold oneself from aiding.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The use may describe withdrawal because of an exculpating cause or abstention from assistance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become difficult, resistant, impracticable, or impossible.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Commonly said of an affair that does not proceed directly or easily.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of traces or relics, to become effaced or altered and effaced.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used especially of the remains of dwellings or places of settlement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become defiled or besmeared with human ordure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive or intransitive environmental use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fail to adduce an excuse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported contrary Form VIII use; it is distinct from the ordinary use of presenting an excuse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To complain of someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Construed with مِنْ in the cited usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of waters, to stop, cease, or become cut off.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form VIII use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To arrange a turban so that its two ends hang down behind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional clothing-related use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To devirginate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical use distinct from the ordinary excuse sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask or seek to be excused, or to ask another to undertake one's excuse before retaliation or punishment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Often used in a construction with مِنْ and in requests for intervention before acting against someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A state or action by which one seeks to be excusable when carrying out a deserved punishment or other difficult act.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Appears in the conventional expression لَا نُذْرَاكَ, glossed as doing what makes one excusable rather than merely warning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Success, attainment of one's aim, or victory in a contest or battle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct noun sense used in asking whose success or victory belongs to someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a dwelling, having many traces or relics remaining.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of a house or settlement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of land, not yielding herbage freely, or producing growth that soon withers.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of unproductive land.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Virginity, the maidenhead, or the hymen; also the act of devirgination.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The same lexical family may refer to the state, its anatomical sign, or its removal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The first author or originator of something, especially in the idiom “the father of” a devirgination or a saying.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of being the first person to perform or produce something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The external female genital part at which circumcision is performed, or the prepuce of a boy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical sense associated with the part that is cut in circumcision.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sign, mark, or token.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes a token attached to a horse's forelock as a distinguishing or protective mark.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lock or tuft of hair on a horse, including the forelock, mane, or hair on the withers.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The authorities differ over the exact part of the horse's hair intended.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A group or star associated with the intense heat of its heliacal rising.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Astronomical identification varies in the cited descriptions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A painful swelling or ailment of the throat near the uvula.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may denote either the ailment itself or the place in the throat where it occurs, especially in children.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Human dung or ordure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the primary concrete sense in the cited lexical discussion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The court or yard of a house; by extension, a place where people sit in that court.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sense is explained from the practice of throwing ordure into the courtyard; the idiom بَرِيءُ العَذِرَةِ means clear of disgrace.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The worst refuse removed from grain or other food when it is cleaned.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized material sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A virgin woman or girl; by extension, something untouched or unused.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The adjective is used as an epithet and can describe an unbored pearl or sand on which no one has trodden.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The constellation or zodiacal sign Virgo.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional astronomical name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A named group of stars.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural astronomical use related to the star terminology of عُذْرَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A kind of long black grape resembling the dyed fingers of virgins.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional plant or food name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A newly used collar, restraint, or iron instrument for confining or torturing a person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes an instrument placed around the throat or neck to force a confession.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A name for the Prophet's City, al-Madīnah.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The name is explained by its not having been abased.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The cheek-strap or cheek-straps of a bridle, and by extension a halter or related headstall.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The exact configuration varies between descriptions: it may mean one cheek-strap, both cheek-straps, or the corresponding part of a halter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Restraint, shame, or obedience, especially in idioms for determination or throwing off restraint.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Expressions such as خَلَعَ عِذَارَهُ describe abandoning shame or obedience and persisting in error.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The side of the beard or the hair growing in the cheek area in front of the ear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may denote the beard line, either side of the beard, or the corresponding facial area.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The cheek or the place occupied by the cheek-strap.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A body-part use derived from the bridle sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A brand or mark made with a hot iron in the place of the cheek-strap.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used especially of marks on camels or similar animals.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Either sharp edge of the iron head of an arrow, spear, or similar weapon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The two edges together may be called the dual عِذَارَانِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Either side or edge of a road, valley, or wall.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A spatial edge or boundary sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A row of trees or palm trees.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective linear-landscape use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An elongated tract of sand, or one of two such tracts or roads.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited poetic interpretation allows either elongated sand ridges or corresponding roads.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A rugged tract of ground or sand lying across a wide plain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A terrain description distinct from the narrower road-edge sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Resistance or refusal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Explained as a noun associated with تَعَذُّر.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An excuser, advocate, aider, or assistant against an enemy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression مَنْ عَذِيرِي asks who will excuse, defend, or assist the speaker before retaliation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A state, purpose, or action one seeks and for which one would be excusable.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in poetic speech for an intended journey or undertaking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A disposition to excuse; willingness to pardon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression مَا عِنْدَهُمْ عَذِيرَةٌ means that they do not excuse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A reported synonym of a word meaning pleasant, good, or well-provided.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The identification is reported tentatively in the cited lexicographical material.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Evil-tempered, vehement, or clamorous in disposition and command.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive descriptive adjective; the explanation connects it figuratively with needing an excuse for wrongdoing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an ass, wide in the belly or chest and strongly biting or lewd.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An animal-specific adjectival use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of dominion, broad, ample, or strong.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative descriptive use applied to sovereignty or rule.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Agile or brisk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported in additional lexicographical and poetic authorities.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A scar or mark left by a wound, rain, or another impact.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of something that leaves a visible trace upon a person or object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The vein from which blood of irregular menstruation flows.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form may be a dialectal variant or a case of altered pronunciation; the cited discussion also connects it with an excuse for the woman.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A line-like brand or mark made with a hot iron.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized branding noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The part cut off from the female circumcision site.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical noun associated with the place called عُذْرَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A feast or repast prepared for a circumcision, a joyful event, completion of a building, or acquisition of something new.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The circumcision feast is the most common cited use, while other celebratory occasions are also recorded.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A plea, allegation, or argument offered as an excuse; in a Yemeni usage, a veil or covering.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural is associated with the Quranic interpretation of مَعَاذِير as either pleas or coverings over offenses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Excused, cleared, exempted from blame, or exculpated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The passive-participial adjective describes one for whom an excuse has been accepted or established.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman experiencing irregular menstruation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized feminine use, explained as a woman excused from certain obligations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Circumcised.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized passive-participial use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a camel, branded with the mark called عِذَار.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An animal-specific passive-participial use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Affected by the throat ailment called عُذْرَة.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily-condition use, especially of a child.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who excuses himself or offers a plea, whether the plea is truthful or not.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form is contrasted with مُعَذِّر for one who falls short and feigns an excuse; the cited Quranic reading discussion is not treated as a separate canonical QAC form.

cautions: The Quranic plural مَعَاذِير is merged under the singular public headword مَعْذِرَة while retaining its distinct Quranic covering/plea interpretation.

Lane records variant Quranic readings around مُعَذِّرُون and related forms; the artifact represents the canonical QAC form and states the lightened-reading distinction without creating an unsupported additional QAC form.
Several عذر derivatives have independent concrete or technical meanings; they should not be inferred as direct meanings of every Quranic form.
